# pistol solver DEEP fixture v0 — WP-1.8a's deep positions.
#
# The eight decoy wins: the canonical-first policy pair is a failing decoy,
# the search re-selects onto the overload pair. 40-92 nodes, 38-90 seesaw
# events each. These are EXCLUDED from gate (a)'s R3' differential — R3' is
# measured intractable on them (25+ min, no verdict, one position) — and are
# covered instead by gate (b)'s independent full-width verifier, the design's
# own instrument for deep positions. Pinned separately in
# tests/common/fixture_loader.rs (SOLVER_DEEP_V0_SHA256).

case decoy-0
plies 0,0 1,1 2,1 -1,1 -1,2 0,3 0,4 -2,3 -2,4 2,2 3,2 -2,5 1,3 5,1 5,2 -1,4 -3,3 -6,-1 -6,0 7,-1 7,1
expect win
